canonical.title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock with Cooldown
canonical.sourceFilePath: 14. Dynamic Programming/6. DP on Stocks/05. Buy and sell stocks with cooldown.cpp

narrative.title: The Cooling-Down Cargo Bay
narrative.scenario: After every release, the broker's cargo bay must pass a one-hour safety inspection before another lock can open — a mandatory cooldown. Trades remain unlimited otherwise. Dispatch needs the schedule that still maximizes total spread while respecting the forced stand-down hour after each sale.
narrative.inputFormat: An array prices where prices[i] is the fee on hour i.
narrative.outputFormat: Return the maximum total profit with unlimited transactions and a one-hour cooldown after every sell.

testCases.explanation: Lock at 1, release at 2, stand down at 0, lock at 0, release at 2 — total 3.
A single lock at 1 and release at 4 clears the cooldown for free.

hintLevels: Level 1: The only change from unlimited trades is what a sell does to the clock — it skips an extra hour.
Level 2: After selling at hour i, the next legal buy is hour i+2; encode that by jumping two days in the sell branch.
Level 3: Three states — holding, resting, just-sold — make the transition table explicit and bug-resistant.
